reviews.title: AS3 AIR virtual filesystem, relational SQL engine, desktop/windowing, and events
reviews.summary: Implements the shared Rust AirRuntime (virtual AIR filesystem with read-only app:/ roots, EncryptedLocalStore, AIR 32.0 descriptor XML, and relational SQLite-compatible engine), WASM AirKernel, web/air.js host adapters, and AS3 compiler builtins/IFilePromise contracts across flash.filesystem, flash.data, flash.desktop, flash.display, flash.events, and companion AIR packages.
